The '''E-1R Legion rifle''' was a model of [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] used by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] around the time of the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR:PI" />

==History==
[[File:Imperial_soldiers_with_new_riffles.jpg|right|thumb|280px|Imperial soldiers wearing E-1R Legion rifles]]
The E-1R Legion rifle was one of the primary weapons of the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] during the Third Galactic War.<ref name="TOR:PI" /><ref name="TOR:StT">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=faction|Republic|Springing the Trap|Onderon}}</ref><ref name="TOR:DtD">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=faction|Republic|Defending the Docks|Mek-Sha}}</ref><ref name="TOR:AFoT">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=faction|Imperial|A Favor or Two|Ord Mantell}}</ref> It was used by [[Imperial soldier]]s and [[Darth Savik]]'s [[Darth Savik's remote droid|battle droids]] during the [[Mission to Onderon (3627 BBY)|mission to Onderon]],<ref name="TOR:PI" /><ref name="TOR:StT" /> and by Imperial troops during the [[mission to Mek-Sha]].<ref name="TOR:DtD" /> E-1R Legion rifles were also used by Imperial soldiers during the [[Invasion of Manaan]]<ref name="TOR:HIB">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=location|Hidden Imperial Base|Manaan}}</ref> and equipped Imperial soldiers serving [[Darth Krovos]] during the [[raid on Kessan's Landing]].<ref name="TOR:AFoT" /> The E-1R Legion rifle was also the primary weapon of [[Jilo Del]] of [[Krallet Division]].<ref name="TOR:RitR">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|exp=lots|Retribution in the Rift|Manaan}}</ref>
